// diagnostic E3001

Jet.Panic

`panic: {msg}`

What

`panic: {msg}`

Why

The program hit a `panic`, `assert`, or `assert_eq` call that failed, a bounds/key check triggered at runtime, or another program-side stop. The shared report boundary owns the program-side stop; an unhandled entry error is a returned report, not E3001. Jet file and line are shown in Jet terms.

Fix

Fix the logic that led to the failure. Program-side stops exit 70 through the shared boundary; unhandled entry errors print their report and exit 1; exit 101 is reserved for Jet defects.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.Panic: Tests/UI/env_config_decode_error.stderr.

Stop: Jet.Panic: `panic: config: [at `port`: E2416: env var APP_PORT -> port: expected Int, found text "not-an-int"]`
  --> Tests/UI/env_config_decode_error.jet:16 in run
     |
16 |     settings: env.decode<Settings>(prefix: "APP_", file: "", allow: ["APP_PORT"]) ?? panic("config: {err}")
     |                                                                                      ^^^^^

The shared report boundary owns the program-side stop; an unhandled entry error is a returned report, not E3001. Jet file and line are shown in Jet terms.
